WandaVision - Season 1

Blending the style of classic sitcoms with the MCU, WandaVision follows Wanda Maximoff and Vision, two super-powered beings trying to live an idealized suburban life. Their world appears cheerful, familiar and perfectly arranged, but as their routine continues, the pair begin to sense that something about their seemingly perfect existence is not what it seems.
